design_context: Premium Dashboard & Finance SaaS for Indonesian Families
theme_strategy: ARCHETYPE 5: LUXURY (Premium, Depth, Mystery). We are using a sophisticated Dark Theme to emulate high-end wealth management platforms (like Copilot and Monarch). The base is a deep, warm Obsidian/Charcoal. Surfaces will use subtle glassmorphism and 'optical clarity' rather than heavy gradients. Accents are jewel tones tied to Indonesian financial brands.

typography.headings: Playfair Display (For large Net Worth numbers, dashboard headers, and hero titles. Exudes trust, elegance, and 'Old Money').
typography.body: Manrope (Crisp, modern, highly readable geometric sans for dense transaction data, forms, and UI elements).
typography.currency_format: IDR only: 'Rp 1.500.000' (Thousands separator is period, no decimals, single space after Rp).
typography.instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Do NOT use Inter, Roboto, or Space Grotesk. Use Playfair Display for primary figures (Net Worth). Use Manrope with `tabular-nums` utility for transaction amounts so numbers align perfectly vertically. Enforce tight tracking `tracking-tight` on large headers.

colors.instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Avoid purple/violet gradients across the main UI (except for specific OVO brand tags if needed, but no global purple). Use `bg-white/5` with `backdrop-blur-xl` and a delicate `border-white/10` for premium cards. DO NOT use completely transparent backgrounds where content scrolls underneath.

layouts.dashboard_grid: Bento Grid Protocol: High Density Grid. Use grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. Spacing should be generous (`gap-6` to `gap-8`) to allow the dark theme to breathe.
layouts.alignment: Left-align dense transaction data. Only use optical centering for primary CTA buttons or empty states. NO generic centered page structures.
layouts.instructions_to_main_agent: Use `grid` for the dashboard layout. Ensure grid children stretch using `h-full`. Use generous padding (`p-6` or `p-8`) inside cards to prevent data clutter.

NetWorthCard.style: The Hero Card. Spans 2 columns on desktop. Features a massive Playfair Display figure. Use a 'Tracing Beam' effect or a subtle gold/bronze 1px inner border (`border-[#C5A880]/30`) to elevate its status. Include a soft radial glow behind the number.
NetWorthCard.behavior: Hover lifts the card slightly with `shadow-2xl`.

AccountCards.style: Neumorphic-glass blend. Flat dark background (`bg-[#141414]`) with a 1px solid border. The top edge of the card should have a 2px colored highlight indicating the bank (e.g., BCA Blue, GoPay Green).
AccountCards.layout: Flexbox, bank logo/icon on top left, balance bottom right.

TransactionRow.style: Minimalist list item. No individual cards for rows. Use a bottom border `border-white/5` to separate.
TransactionRow.elements: Left: Category Icon (in a soft tinted circle). Middle: Description & Date. Right: Amount (`text-emerald-500` or `text-white`) and a Privacy Lock icon (for PRIVATE) or Avatar stack (for SHARED).

FamilyWorkspaceAvatar.style: Use negative margin `-ml-2` for stacked avatars. Add a 2px `border-[#0A0A0A]` around each avatar to create a cut-out effect. Avatar sizes should be small `w-8 h-8`.

SidebarNav.style: Left-side vertical navigation (or top nav with glassmorphism). MUST have a visible navigation layout on desktop, do not hide behind a hamburger.

visual_enhancers.borders_and_shadows: Use 1px borders of `white/10` for structural separation. Shadows should be ambient and deep (`shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.4)]`).
visual_enhancers.motion: Staggered entrance animations for dashboard cards and transaction rows using framer-motion. Hover states must subtly lighten the background (`hover:bg-white/10`).

hero_background.description: Dark, rippling abstract texture with reflective surfaces

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and glass-morphism effects (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., `transition: all`). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, i.e., do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the CSS file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use Phosphor Icons (`@phosphor-icons/react`) or Lucide.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute in kebab-case.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over glassmorphism or backgrounds maintains minimum 4.5:1 ratio (WCAG AA).
accessibility.focus_states: Use `focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#C5A880] focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-offset-[#0A0A0A]` for all inputs and buttons.

icons.usage: Use icons heavily in transaction rows and account cards. Lock icon for private, Eye icon for shared.
